title: Access to roof-mounted HVAC equipment: guidance across NBC(AE) Article 3.6.4.7 and CSA B149.1:25
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023; the document states the NBC(AE) 1st printing currently references CSA B149.1:20 (edition control: project rule requires 2nd printing; treat as a caveat)
document_date: Date Issued: June 2026 (platform created June 1, 2026, last updated June 1, 2026)

facts.text: The bulletin provides guidance on access to roof-mounted HVAC equipment installed under NBC(AE) and the CSA B149.1 gas-code references.
The document states that the NBC(AE) 1st printing currently references the CSA B149.1:20 edition.
Building Safety Codes Officers, designers and contractors reported confusion and inconsistent application of these code provisions across the province.
The CSA B149.1:25 came into force on March 1, 2026.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.
Case type is the nearest enum value; this is not an issued variance, appeal or worked example.

Joint Building/Gas bulletin. Edition-control caveat: the document itself says the NBC(AE) 1st printing references CSA B149.1:20; project rule prefers the 2nd printing, which is not stated in the document.

Edition check: the Aug 2026 second-printing notice (attached as supporting evidence) says the NBC(AE) 2nd printing includes revisions and errata released 17 Aug 2026. This bulletin (June 2026) refers to the 1st printing; whether the 2nd printing changed the CSA B149.1 reference was not checked.

Edition check: alberta.ca lists the NBC(AE) 2023 2nd printing (published 17 Aug 2026) as in force; the article wording quoted here is as the STANDATA document states it and was not checked against the 2nd printing text (not in the package).
